question: The house of P is 5 km west of the house of Q. The house of R is 3 km north of the house of Q. The house of S is 10 km south of the house of R. In which direction is the house of S from the house of Q?
solution:
Logic followed here is based on the directional relationship between the houses.

**Step 1: Positioning P and R relative to Q**

 
• House P is 5 km West of House Q.
 
• House R is 3 km North of House Q.

**Step 2: Positioning S relative to R**

The house of S is 10 km south of the house of R.

Since R is 3 km North of Q, moving south from R involves passing through the position of Q:

 
• Distance from R to Q = 3 km (South direction)
 
• Remaining distance from Q to S = Total distance - Distance to Q
 
• Remaining distance = 10 km - 3 km = 7 km

**Conclusion:**

As House S is 7 km directly below House Q on the North-South axis, it is located in the South direction.

Therefore, the house of S is **South** from the house of Q.
